items.title: Approve the Minutes of the June 11, 2024 Meeting Consent Agenda

[Final Approval] Adopt the Proposed Fiscal Year 2024/25 Budget and Work Program
[Final Approval] Approve Revised Administrative Code; Debt and Fiscal Policies; and Ratify the Investment Policy Other Items
